Expand Seamlessly into EU & UK
with empact’s VAT all-in-one Solution

Exhausted from VAT compliance? empact takes it away instantly, seamlessly and fully, covering all 27 EU member states & the UK market just in a few clicks.
We are the only platform which removes the entire responsibility and burden from you to us. It is our mission and commitment to ensure your business is being compliant 24/7 while you can finally focus on your core business and we remove your VAT pains away.

Start now

Seamless Cross-Border eCommerce!  

The ultimate and only cross-border platform which removes instantly all operational and VAT compliance barriers and challenges to take your business to the next level. empact’s platform shapes the Cross-border world by combining TaxTech innovation with smart supply chain algorithm, enabling any business an instant, seamless and cost efficient solution to act as local from afar. Our innovative approach is based on a granted license from the EU authorities, acting as local Merchant Of Records (MOR) supervised by the authorities combined with smart technology which streamlines sales, supply chains transactions, and VAT compliance processes into One-Stop-Shop platform that covers all your business needs.

Integrations

Connecting your eCommerce platforms, ERPs, and 3PLs is seamless with empact thanks to it’s innovative Data Sync feature, which removes all the high resources and barriers invested in API integrations.

empact Data Sync

The ultimate feature developed by empact to eliminate the enormous resources invested into creation of API integrations or its maintenance.

With empact’s Data Sync feature, there is no need for API integration any longer, which means that data can be received on our side seamlessly by only simple sales reports issued from any online shop or ERP system with no limitations.
